what_it_is.prose: India operates 22 AH-64E Apaches with the Indian Air Force and completed the six-aircraft Indian Army order in 2025. Boeing identifies Tata Boeing Aerospace Limited (TBAL) in Hyderabad as a global sole-source Apache fuselage producer. The original Indian order covered 22 aircraft and the later Army procurement added six more. This establishes operational Indian service and a documented Indian aerospace manufacturing role without converting local aerostructure work into an unsupported indigenous-content percentage.
